summary: Adds a card inventory workbook (issue #150): docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx lists every card in the reference catalogue (content/deck-pool.json, 2,143 cards) with its Type and Wired/Unwired status, cross-referenced against every content/published/*.json wave by card Id. Generated by tools/content/build_card_inventory.py (new openpyxl dependency), never hand-edited -- rerun it as part of any PR that ships a new content wave. Cross-linked from docs/ROADMAP.md's intro, matching its own self-maintenance convention. Shared-file note: touches docs/ROADMAP.md and tools/content/ only, no engine or client code; purely a content-tracking artifact.
validation: python3 tools/content/build_card_inventory.py runs clean (2143 cards, 139 wired, matching the published-card count from the just-merged Follower Wave 2 PR); the script raises on any wired id not found in deck-pool.json, and none were raised. Workbook read back and spot-checked against the known published-card list.
